audience: professionals who take bookings and meetings through Appntmnts

useCases.title: Find open slots for a meeting
useCases.text: List the event types. Then read the open start times for one type on a day, or across up to 31 days.

useCases.title: Review this week's bookings
useCases.text: List the bookings with a status or date filter. Open one for its time, customer and meeting link.

useCases.title: Book a meeting for an attendee
useCases.text: Pick an open slot from the slot list, then create the booking. The attendee gets a confirmation, and a retry can create a second booking.

useCases.title: Cancel a booking
useCases.text: Read the booking, then cancel it. The normal cancellation e-mails are sent, and the cancellation cannot be undone here.
